history.summary: GENERIC-NAME FLAG: 'Shivalayam Temple' is a generic name with many candidates in Sangareddy district (Cherlagudam, Kalabgoor, GITAM University Rd, Nandikandi, Patancheru, Pulkal and others appear in listings), so the identity is PROVISIONAL. Documented as the best-supported in-town referent: Shivalayam Temple Someshwarwada, Someshwara Wada Rd, Sangareddy 502001 (place-listing coords 17.621998, 78.092006; listed hours 5:30 AM-6:00 PM daily).
